reviews.summary: A recent venue-level access risk is verified: Phemex delisted ALICE/USDT spot and ended ALICE deposits/withdrawals on September 18, 2026. This does not identify an issue with the specific ALICE-EUR venue, but can reduce cross-venue liquidity/access.
materialRisks: Phemex delisted ALICE/USDT spot at 07:00 UTC on September 18, 2026, and disabled ALICE deposits and withdrawals there; this is a current venue-access/liquidity fragmentation risk for ALICE. ([phemex.com](https://phemex.com/announcements/phemex-will-delist-the-perp-usdt-spot-pair-100030))

facts.fact: Asset identity assessed as My Neighbor Alice (ALICE); the reported price range and official project sources align with that token.

Phemex's official notice states all ALICE/USDT spot orders were removed at delisting and that ALICE deposits and withdrawals were no longer available after September 18, 2026. ([phemex.com](https://phemex.com/announcements/phemex-will-delist-the-perp-usdt-spot-pair-100030))

No upcoming scheduled vesting unlock was identified: a tokenomics tracker reports ALICE's vesting schedule ended in 2025 and labels the token fully unlocked. ([tokenomist.ai](https://tokenomist.ai/my-neighbor-alice/updates))
